title: Ember and Choir
author: Paloma Okonkwo
blurb: Edmund Winterbourne, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the old gods begin answering prayers again, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
